modelSelection.title: Select task and AI model

modelTypes.graniteDescription: Use it for faster and more accurate results

modelConfiguration.title: Configure model
modelConfiguration.tokenLimitHelper: Enter the maximum number of tokens a model can process in a single request.
modelConfiguration.maxLatencyHelper: Enter a value for the longest amount of time it takes the model to generate a response.
modelConfiguration.repetitionPenaltyHelper: Set a repetition penalty to discourage repeating phrases in the output.
modelConfiguration.temperatureHelper: Set a temperature to control randomness. The higher the number, the more creative the output will be.
modelConfiguration.topKHelper: Specify how many tokens to sample. The minimum value is 1.
modelConfiguration.topPHelper: Specify a cumulative probability score threshold that tokens must reach.
